title: Air Fryer Salmon with Maple Soy Glaze
description: Salmon fillets glazed with maple syrup, soy sauce and a touch of sriracha, air-fried to a sticky finish.
steps: Marinate the salmon in the maple, soy, sriracha and garlic for 20 minutes.
Air fry at 200C for 8-10 minutes, brushing with extra glaze halfway.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste air fryer salmon with maple soy glaze

notes: The sugars in the glaze mean it can burn fast in the air fryer — check it a minute early the first time.
